title: feat(k4cov): k=4 2-site coverage is 66 iff vertex3=1
science: The substantive member of the k=4 sub-series and a second exact iff on the vertex3 bit. Within the four F_cut maps with (wt1,opp2,adj2)=(1,1,1) - exactly the maps with k=4, filling all four long-axis 2-site seeds - two-site coverage is cov=66 iff vertex3=1: the vertex3=1 pair covers all 66 seeds, the vertex3=0 pair covers only 36, and mixed3 is free on both sides. So vertex3 is worth 30 of the 66 two-site seeds here, the same bit that #6444 showed is worth the four shared-face singletons. Confirms again that f_L1 (1,0,1,1,1) is not in this class, since it has opp2=0.
verdict_pair: reverse=none face=none (no (reverse,face) pair stated; pre-verdict campaign phase)
